mode oracle
#! input OPTS1.TXT
#! ini OPTS1.INI
#! secs 40
#! irq
load TTSSEQ30.DLL
call.w SEQWIRE 0001
call.w SEQOPEN 0000 0000
buf 0 16
buf 1 1024
echo == a new sequence
call.w SEQCREATESEQ 0000 0000
call.w SEQGETPPQ 0001
call.w SEQSETSEQPARAM 0001 0007 d:00000000
call.w SEQSETSEQPARAM 0001 0010 d:00000000
call.w SEQSETSEQPARAM 0001 000e d:00000000
echo == send a bank with one sysex message of 300 bytes
call.w SEQCREATESYSXBANK 0001
let 1
fill 1 0 46 30 20 37 44 20 30 30 20 30 31 20 30 32 20 30 33 20 30 34 20 30 35 20 30 36 20 30 37 20 30 38 20 30 39 20 30 41 20 30 42 20 30 43 20 30 44 20 30 45 20 30 46 20 31 30 20 31 31 20 31 32 20 31 33 20 31 34 20 31 35 20 31 36 20 31 37 20 31 38 20 31 39 20 31 41 20 31 42 20 31 43 20 31 44 20 31 45 20 31 46 20 32 30 20 32 31 20 32 32 20 32 33 20 32 34 20 32 35 20
fill 1 120 32 36 20 32 37 20 32 38 20 32 39 20 32 41 20 32 42 20 32 43 20 32 44 20 32 45 20 32 46 20 33 30 20 33 31 20 33 32 20 33 33 20 33 34 20 33 35 20 33 36 20 33 37 20 33 38 20 33 39 20 33 41 20 33 42 20 33 43 20 33 44 20 33 45 20 33 46 20 34 30 20 34 31 20 34 32 20 34 33 20 34 34 20 34 35 20 34 36 20 34 37 20 34 38 20 34 39 20 34 41 20 34 42 20 34 43 20 34 44 20
fill 1 240 34 45 20 34 46 20 35 30 20 35 31 20 35 32 20 35 33 20 35 34 20 35 35 20 35 36 20 35 37 20 35 38 20 35 39 20 35 41 20 35 42 20 35 43 20 35 44 20 35 45 20 35 46 20 36 30 20 36 31 20 36 32 20 36 33 20 30 30 20 30 31 20 30 32 20 30 33 20 30 34 20 30 35 20 30 36 20 30 37 20 30 38 20 30 39 20 30 41 20 30 42 20 30 43 20 30 44 20 30 45 20 30 46 20 31 30 20 31 31 20
fill 1 360 31 32 20 31 33 20 31 34 20 31 35 20 31 36 20 31 37 20 31 38 20 31 39 20 31 41 20 31 42 20 31 43 20 31 44 20 31 45 20 31 46 20 32 30 20 32 31 20 32 32 20 32 33 20 32 34 20 32 35 20 32 36 20 32 37 20 32 38 20 32 39 20 32 41 20 32 42 20 32 43 20 32 44 20 32 45 20 32 46 20 33 30 20 33 31 20 33 32 20 33 33 20 33 34 20 33 35 20 33 36 20 33 37 20 33 38 20 33 39 20
fill 1 480 33 41 20 33 42 20 33 43 20 33 44 20 33 45 20 33 46 20 34 30 20 34 31 20 34 32 20 34 33 20 34 34 20 34 35 20 34 36 20 34 37 20 34 38 20 34 39 20 34 41 20 34 42 20 34 43 20 34 44 20 34 45 20 34 46 20 35 30 20 35 31 20 35 32 20 35 33 20 35 34 20 35 35 20 35 36 20 35 37 20 35 38 20 35 39 20 35 41 20 35 42 20 35 43 20 35 44 20 35 45 20 35 46 20 36 30 20 36 31 20
fill 1 600 36 32 20 36 33 20 30 30 20 30 31 20 30 32 20 30 33 20 30 34 20 30 35 20 30 36 20 30 37 20 30 38 20 30 39 20 30 41 20 30 42 20 30 43 20 30 44 20 30 45 20 30 46 20 31 30 20 31 31 20 31 32 20 31 33 20 31 34 20 31 35 20 31 36 20 31 37 20 31 38 20 31 39 20 31 41 20 31 42 20 31 43 20 31 44 20 31 45 20 31 46 20 32 30 20 32 31 20 32 32 20 32 33 20 32 34 20 32 35 20
fill 1 720 32 36 20 32 37 20 32 38 20 32 39 20 32 41 20 32 42 20 32 43 20 32 44 20 32 45 20 32 46 20 33 30 20 33 31 20 33 32 20 33 33 20 33 34 20 33 35 20 33 36 20 33 37 20 33 38 20 33 39 20 33 41 20 33 42 20 33 43 20 33 44 20 33 45 20 33 46 20 34 30 20 34 31 20 34 32 20 34 33 20 34 34 20 34 35 20 34 36 20 34 37 20 34 38 20 34 39 20 34 41 20 34 42 20 34 43 20 34 44 20
fill 1 840 34 45 20 34 46 20 35 30 20 35 31 20 35 32 20 35 33 20 35 34 20 35 35 20 35 36 20 35 37 20 35 38 20 35 39 20 35 41 20 35 42 20 35 43 20 35 44 20 35 45 20 35 46 20 36 30 20 46 37 00
call.w SEQSYSXASC2BIN %1 @1 @0
call.d SEQGETSYSXBANKLEN %1
call.w SEQSENDSYSXBANK %1 0000 0000
echo == receive two messages of 101 bytes (2000 and 2400 ms)
call.w SEQCREATESYSXBANK 0001
let 2
cbmask f
cbyield 1
cbret 0
sleep 200
cbretafter 2600 1
call.w SEQRECEIVESYSXBANK %2 cb4 0000 0000 0000
cbmask 0
call.d SEQGETSYSXBANKLEN %2
fill 1 0 00
call.w SEQSYSXBIN2ASC %2 @1 0020
dump 1 0 330
echo == record 1100 notes (4000 to 6200 ms)
call.w SEQSETPLAYINGSEQ 0001
call.w SEQSETSTANDBYSEQ 0000
cbret 0
call.w SEQRECORD 0001
call.w SEQSTART cb3 0000 0000
call.w SEQGETRECORDBUFFER
call.w SEQSETRECORDBUFFERPARAMS 0000 0000 0000
idle 3800
call.w SEQGETRECORDBUFFER
call.w SEQRECORD 0000
call.w SEQSTOP
call.d SEQSTREAMLEN 0100
echo == play E2_OVLP (overlapping notes)
call.w SEQLOADCAKEWALKFILE "C:\PROBE\ORC\E2_OVLP.WRK" 0000
call.w SEQSETPLAYINGSEQ 0002
call.w SEQSETSTANDBYSEQ 0000
call.w SEQSTART null 0000 0000
idle 2600
call.w SEQSTOP
idle 200
echo == MIDI Time Code from 00:00:10:00 (11500 to 15000 ms)
call.w SEQSETSRCCLOCK 0002 0003
call.w SEQSETPLAYINGSEQ 0002
fill 0 0 ee ee ee ee
call.w SEQSTART null @0
call.d SEQGETNOW 0002
dump 0 0 4
idle 3500
call.d SEQGETNOW 0002
call.w SEQEXPIRED
call.w SEQCLOSE
